verdict.rationale: The evidence shows IP India runs online e-filing services and publishes forms, fees and a filing-process page. None of it states what account registration, digital credentials or identity-proofing steps a filer must complete before starting. The axis applies to a government filing portal, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
